construct: Paget disease progresses through osteolytic, mixed, and osteosclerotic phases. Excess osteoclast activity is followed by compensatory but disorganized osteoblast activity, generating coarse mechanically weak bone with a characteristic mosaic/jigsaw pattern of lamellar bone and elevated bone-specific alkaline phosphatase.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Older age, enlarged skull, hearing loss, isolated high ALP, patchy sclerosis, and mosaic cement lines identify Paget disease with high-turnover remodeling.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Osteomalacia can cause bone pain and abnormal mineralization, but it does not produce the characteristic mosaic histology or the osteoclast-first/osteoblast-second remodeling sequence.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The biochemical and histologic pattern uniquely supports increased osteoclastic resorption followed by disorganized osteoblastic formation.
